src: sparse same-color dot objects and the upper-left source/fill legend
dst: paint each object's bbox expanded by one pixel
transform: clear the legend; fill pixels that are not original dots inside each expanded bbox with the paired fill color and preserve the original dots
multi_step: process legend rows bottom-to-top so earlier rows have priority where expanded bboxes overlap
symbol_instructions: upper-left source/fill legend maps each dot color to its expanded-bbox fill color
